correctness.rationale: Exact 128-coordinate signed-block recurrence proves a level-four periodic transfer. Four complete base-coordinate identities and induction give a factored annihilating polynomial. A primitive-state eigenprojection yields (1,2,1,2)/6 with uniform square-root block error, and a dyadic block partition covers all N. Four generating functions are checked from sufficient coefficients and a common annihilating denominator; a noncancelled pole at |z|=1/sqrt(2) proves sharpness. The included Python standard-library certificate recomputes every finite algebra identity and independently compares the first 65,536 terms.

value.rationale: Determines all four natural residue densities, their exact imbalance, every dyadic-prefix frequency through four rational functions, and the optimal error power for a naturally studied Thue–Morse Fibonacci recurrence. Uniform primitive-block transfer is an explanatory structural lemma and proves ordinary density rather than only dyadic sampling; sharp pole cancellation analysis shows the oscillations cannot decay faster.
